description: This file implements the PersistentStore class, including initialization, deinitialization, and internal management of store interfaces within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It handles resource management, configuration, and registration of store components.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Main class managing persistent storage within the plugin, including initialization, cleanup, and interface querying.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the persistent store, sets up configuration, and registers interfaces.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters interfaces, and releases references.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.
